compatibility_scope: Translate PSpice syntax in .include model files. Use psa only if the complete input deck needs PSpice translation.
initialization_instructions: Set SPICE_USERINIT_DIR and SPICE_SCRIPTS only in the child process environment. SPICE_SCRIPTS should point to Spice64/share/ngspice/scripts. Run with working directory Spice64/bin so the shipped spinit relative code-model paths resolve. Use absolute circuit, include, log, and raw-output paths. Do not use -n when loading this local init. No system PATH or user-home .spiceinit modifications are needed.
